mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.5% reflects a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% (based on rolling 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.7% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth and increases risk aversion, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), higher discount rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, reducing construction sector activity and overall economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a broad-based consumer demand slowdown that depresses corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 5.0% signals an easing monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.
